decisions.title: Pull Is a Teaching Extra; Codex Still Pushes
decisions.description: Root seeds t1/t2/t3 and stops assigning. Workers poll s12's TaskBoard. Real Codex Multi-Agent V2 stays parent-orchestrated (spawn_agent / followup_task / wait_agent). CSV fan-out still pushes one worker per row. This chapter does not invent a Codex claim API.
decisions.alternatives: Keep root pointing at each teammate (s16). That scales with the number of tasks and is what Codex actually does.

zh.title: Pull 是教学加的；Codex 仍是推
zh.description: root 只写 t1/t2/t3，不再点名。工人轮询 s12 的 TaskBoard。真实 Multi-Agent V2 仍是父编排（spawn_agent / followup_task / wait_agent）。CSV 批量仍是按行推出工人。本章不发明 Codex 认领 API。

decisions.title: scan() Is a Clue; claim() Is the Promise
decisions.description: Two workers may unlocked-scan the same pending row (TOCTOU). claim() sleeps to widen the race, then re-checks inside a mutex so exactly one owner is written. The loser re-scans instead of retrying the same id.
decisions.alternatives: A single locked scan+claim is simpler but hides the stale-read. Letting both proceed without a re-check double-runs the task.

zh.title: scan() 是线索，claim() 才是承诺
zh.description: 两个工人可以无锁扫到同一份 pending（TOCTOU）。claim() 用 sleep 撑开竞争窗口，再在互斥锁里复查，只写一个 owner。输家再扫，而不是重抢同一个 id。

decisions.title: Dependencies Stay on the Board
decisions.description: t3 stays unclaimable until t1 and t2 are done. That is s12's blockedBy rule under concurrency, not a new protocol kind and not git-worktree isolation (s18).
decisions.alternatives: Ignore deps and let anyone grab t3 early. The board would no longer be a shared source of truth.

zh.title: 依赖仍在板上
zh.description: t3 要等 t1 和 t2 都 done 才能认领。这是 s12 的 blockedBy 在并发下继续生效，不是新的信封 kind，也不是 git worktree 隔离（s18）。
